source_evidence: In some cases, fees are negotiable, so you can talk to your broker about reducing them.
answer: To compare brokerage fees, look beyond the commission: brokers may also charge miscellaneous fees, and these can differ between firms. Review your account notices and trade confirmations; if charges are bundled together, you can request a breakdown. If a fee seems high, ask the broker about it and whether it can be reduced. You can also shop around, while considering any costs or tax consequences of closing or transferring your account.
